title: Thwackdown! gameplay demo CPU vs CPU - an open source PC native retro inspired wrestling game set in 2000 based on Smackdown! 2 for the PS1
author: JJBareaIsLeFather
selftext:
I have been working on this for about 2 weeks off and on between my other main projects. So far I have a generic match demo with two generic place holder wrestlers, and basic systems to assign moves. I have about 40 animations total in the game so far, some better or worse less or more polished than others. 

The biggest chunk of time has been spent on the animations and ring physics and getting the wrestlers and ref to all interact with each other correctly. I have learned in this process that wrestling games are by no means simple to make with the amount of interacting systems and animations and positioning to consider. 

I plan to keep going until every wrestler from Smackdown 2 is in the game in a copywrite free way, while allowing compatibility with original game assets for people who want to import them. I plan to add the season mode, make a custom universe mode, create a superstar, and many other features, as well as add other wrestlers from the PS1/n64 era and more legends to make it the ultimate PC wrestling retro game, while allowing customization for anyone who wants to import custom rosters and assets to make it how they want it to be. 

I consider right now a developer build only and still have many months of work left realistically before I can release a public demo.
